name: Voltaic Resonance Disruptor VRD-3 'Livewire'
description:
The Voltaic Resonance Disruptor operates by generating a tuned electromagnetic carrier wave that couples directly with the bioelectric field of living targets. Developed under ZHENG-DAO BIOELECTRIC's 'Project Harmonic' initiative, the VRD-3 emits a modulated burst that oscillates at frequencies specifically calibrated to interfere with sodium-potassium ion exchange across cell membranes. The result is a cascading depolarization event that spreads outward from the point of initial contact like a stone dropped in still water, disrupting voluntary motor function without causing immediate tissue death.

What distinguishes the VRD-3 from cruder electroshock platforms is its precision tuning system — a rotating dial on the receiver allows operators to shift the resonance band between incapacitation, sustained agony, and lethal cardiac interference. This tunability earned the weapon considerable interest from both law enforcement contractors and private security firms, though the lethal setting has since been restricted under Meridian 88's Bioelectric Harm Ordinance 7.4. Field technicians have long known that a simple hardware bypass restores full-spectrum functionality, and modification kits circulate freely in the lower districts.

The weapon's distinctive high-pitched harmonic whine during charge-up — colloquially called 'singing' — has made it impossible to deploy with any element of surprise. Experienced street operators have learned to exploit this: the sound alone is often enough to provoke compliance before a shot is ever fired. In the Shunt district, a drawn Livewire is understood as a social ultimatum.
specifications:
effective range: 18m (optimal), 30m (degraded)
charge time: 1.4 seconds
power source: ZHENG-DAO ZD-7 Galvanic Cell (12 shots per cell)
weight: 1.9 kg
length: 34 cm
settings: Incapacitation, Sustained Pain, Lethal (restricted)
resonance bands: 40 Hz – 220 Hz adjustable
housing: Matte polymer over conductive internal cage
tactical_use: Preferred in close-quarters detention and crowd suppression. Security operators typically use the incapacitation band to drop targets without lethal liability, then transition to physical restraint. Corporate extraction teams use modified units with the lethal band enabled for quiet termination operations where ballistic evidence must be avoided. The weapon's limited range makes it poorly suited for open engagements; operators typically close distance using cover before deploying.
cultural_context: The Livewire has become a class symbol in Meridian 88 — specifically, a symbol of institutional violence with plausible deniability. Corporate security personnel carry them openly as a statement of licensed authority. In the lower districts, possessing an unmodified VRD-3 signals someone with corporate ties or aspirations. A modified unit, by contrast, signals someone who has cut those ties and doesn't care who knows it. Street medics have developed protocols specifically for treating resonance cascade injuries, which they call 'singing sickness.'
known_users: Modified-unit carriers in the Shunt district underworld
story_hooks: A ZHENG-DAO whistleblower claims the VRD-3's lethal band was never actually restricted — only the documentation was changed. She has internal firmware logs to prove it.
A string of deaths in the Velour District show all the biological markers of cardiac resonance failure, but no VRD-3s are recovered at any scene. Someone is using an undetectable delivery method.
The modification kits flooding the market are suspiciously uniform — same machining tolerances, same component sourcing. Someone is manufacturing them at scale and distributing them deliberately.

A licensed security operator's VRD-3 spontaneously shifted to lethal band during a routine detention, killing the subject. The operator swears they never touched the dial. ZHENG-DAO is quietly buying the case files.
